spiritual_reading.full_translation:
When opposition from active falsity rose up out of obscurity, it was subdued by a sufficient series of Divine operations.

The first operation is the inmost Divine Itself, abiding in peace and unsearchable interiority, remaining within its own wisdom in the purity of its own being.

From that inmost Divine, derivative operations came forth into manifestation. They were disposed into complete conjunction as to the working powers in the outer degree, and they were established as an entire organized body in fullness.

The second operation proceeded and came into manifestation, revealed from the first. It is the wisdom-principle in living activity, together with the good that first engages evil in order to restore order, and with a sufficient complement of subordinate operative powers acting from that good.

The third operation is love for all truths and goods ordering and forming them for use: the living proceeding Divine that builds and disposes, together with a sufficient complement of subordinate powers proceeding from it for executing its uses.

The fourth operation is mediation in its third degree, together with the upholding Divine that sustains what has been arranged, and with all the luminous powers of understanding and use brought forth through it.

The fifth operation proceeding from the inmost Divine is truth in splendour as it reaches the outermost, together with all the powers it calls forth for operation—its derivations that pour forth and come into manifestation from it.

This was arranged so that the Divine operations might be extended in sufficient series: one sufficiency as the subordinate powers of the first engaging good distributed into full function and support, and another sufficiency as the subordinate powers of the living proceeding Divine extended into a full set of positions and uses, sustaining the ordered whole.

Thus the whole was made complete in organized fullness. To that fullness two were added—reception and compliance—so that responsive conjunction might exist. These were appointed as a succeeding principle in place of the Divine splendour in the lower degree, to govern the outermost plane in which all things are held together.

The descent of the first engaging good occurred as when noble truth from a higher state is present among those of its own spiritual household, yet is assailed by opposing falsities and suffers from their evil. They strip from it what is serviceable and abundant, confine it under their dominion, and attempt to deprive it of its attendant powers; yet it endures by humility, gathers courage, and restrains the opposing force by withholding consent, remaining in interior peace.

As noble truth is surrounded by adversaries, so this descent took place among dominant falsities, the adversaries of illumination.

But the descent of the living proceeding Divine and the mandate it received, by which it came upon the dominant falsities, differs from the first descent.

This descent of the living proceeding Divine is that it was sent from the Divine operations to lift up the first engaging good. It is like authoritative judgment from the highest order overturning the violence done to noble truth by falsities that violated order. That judgment is executed with unwavering firmness against what is cruel and perverted; it provides means of restoration through righteousness and strength; it evaluates and condemns all that is condemned by rebellious intention, repaying each according to its quality. What requires sharp correction it chastises; what must be deprived of ability to harm it renders powerless in the faculties by which it injured; what must be held fast it binds in lasting constraint, fixing it in inverted states; what is wholly against good it extinguishes as to power of acting, so that the destructive tendency is brought to an end; what must be removed from former influence it casts out from the spheres in which it dwelt, according to just order.

The associate powers within this hidden working, belonging to that judgment in great strength, instantly execute the will of the governing Divine.

As authoritative judgment was sent from the highest order to overturn violence done to noble truth, so it was with the living proceeding Divine. It was sent from the Divine of illumination to overturn vengeance and oppression against the first engaging good, which the ruling falsity of the obscured domain had committed with its rebellious derivatives; therefore, when the living proceeding Divine came, it raised up the first engaging good.

It also judged all dominant falsities and evils that had violated order against the subordinate operative powers of that first engaging good. It fixed them in constraint in higher and lower degrees, assigning each to the state fitting to it and weighing each by its cruelty and oppression: some it shut within interior restraints; others it turned into complete inversion; some it fixed in grievous exposure and immobilization; others it forced into perpetual passivity. Some it placed beneath the influence of their like, limited by strong restriction; others it allowed to hold delegated dominance over those beneath them, so that their delight might be spent upon those in similar disorder.

Know, then, that when the Divine of life set order by these judgments, it was made manifest even to the powers of obscurity. It judged them as genuine judgment itself. This was the first judgment the living proceeding Divine executed upon the dominant falsities in respect to the first engaging good: it gave victory to that good according to the nature of its victory, and it condemned the ruling falsity of the obscured domain according to the manner of its perversion.

Thus the fixed constraint remained in the outermost degree until the end, when the entire formed system is dissolved: evil perishes by final ardour brought to consummation and separation is made. What is of illumination returns to its proper state; what is of obscurity remains in everlasting restraint.

The descent of the third mediating Divine, when it came to examine those held bound in the intermediate region, is like governing providence inspecting those performing uses and maintaining order.

It discerns those who are good in their functions—those who form, arrange, and execute within each assigned position—and sees that they have worked well and have entered the uses of the whole according to their proper form. It rejoices and confirms those who carried out the ordered work and fulfilled what was commanded.

As governing providence inspects its ordered works and the protections of order, so is this descent. When it came, it saw the ordered structures established and prepared, and it saw the series of dominant falsities disposed and fixed in their places above and below, outwardly and inwardly, according to the great pattern the preceding operations had made. It saw the heavenly and spiritual ministrations established, administering the protections of order and guarding the whole government of states—those first operations: the first engaging good, the living proceeding Divine, and the wisdom-principle in living activity.

Seeing that all had been formed and ordered with great wisdom, it brought what was hidden to disclosure and by its presence made itself manifest to them. It affirmed the living proceeding Divine’s execution of judgment as being according to order, so that each received what fit its state, though some were moved and lifted into states beyond what they merited.

The descent of truth in splendour to the states below is like decisive purification sent to uproot what is obstinately evil and to consume a difficult network of perverted perceptions by ardent love. It first removes hardened falsities by the cutting power of truth, and it extirpates root-intentions, consuming their persuasions by purifying ardour so that they do not revive or bring forth destructive works.

Afterward it implants living good and living truth that bring forth beneficial works.

So it was with truth in splendour: it went forth in power and wisdom in the lower degree, and by glorious wisdom destroyed resisting evils and falsities. It bound and crushed them as consuming ardour destroys what is perverted in perception and its resulting works. Thus it carried out its will in the intermediate region among many powers, until it reached the outermost human state in its first formed condition, where the first recipient stood ready. It completed its work in the receptive affection and purified it; it gave hope to the understanding and announced restoration and illumination; then it elevated that state toward higher reception of light.

Then responsive conjunction—reception and compliance—proceeding into the ultimate constituents set in mutual bond, entered into them and remained held in interior peace. It sustains the ordered process until the end, when it can arise and stand firm in the final ardour that makes separation. It gathers to itself what is its own life, forms it into the final unified human form of order, and purges away whatever is impure and alien to it. But the life and illumination dispersed through all states it gathers into itself and builds into its own organized fullness.

When this final unified form is perfected in all its powers and functions, it becomes free and ascends out of the great contention through the living proceeding Divine as its originating support, which comes and brings each power into its place, lifting it out from the midst of the collecting and separating process in which all things are brought to their end.

This counsel of responsive conjunction is like gentle good held in a calm state: when introduced into living truth warmed by love, it yields and permeates that truth. It is received quietly into the inmost of that truth; then whatever is vital and delightful in that truth is drawn into the conjunction. Afterward what is cold, inert, and unsuitable is clarified and cast away, but what is pure, rich, and beautiful is gathered into the conjunction.

So also is the descent of that living counsel—responsive conjunction—into the ultimate constituents: at the end it arises and stands firm, gathering into itself all lives and the illumination that remained hidden throughout every state, building them into its own organized form so that they abide in its image to eternity from that time.

paragraph_translations.translation: When opposition from active falsity rose up out of obscurity, it was subdued by a sufficient series of Divine operations.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONTINUES the opening conflict by stating its spiritual resolution.

paragraph_translations.translation: The first operation is the inmost Divine Itself, abiding in peace and unsearchable interiority, remaining within its own wisdom in the purity of its own being.
paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS by defining the source-operation from which all others proceed.
paragraph_translations.notes: "Light-earth" required compression into an inmost state of pure wisdom; its exact nuance is uncertain.

paragraph_translations.translation: From that inmost Divine, four derivative operations came forth into manifestation. They were disposed into complete conjunction as to the working powers in the outer degree, and they were established as an entire organized body in fullness.
paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS by describing the ordered emergence and structuring of derived operations.
paragraph_translations.notes: The movement from "ten" to "twelve" is preserved as functional completeness and fullness without retaining numeric schema.

paragraph_translations.translation: The second operation proceeded and came into manifestation, revealed from the first: the wisdom-principle in living activity, together with the good that first engages evil to restore order, and with a sufficient complement of subordinate operative powers acting from that good.
paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS by specifying the second operation and its internal powers.
paragraph_translations.notes: The named cluster required translation by function; fine distinctions among titles are not fully recoverable.

paragraph_translations.translation: The third operation is love for all truths and goods ordering and forming them for use: the living proceeding Divine that builds and disposes, together with a sufficient complement of subordinate powers proceeding from it for executing its uses.
paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS by adding the next operation as formative providence in action.

paragraph_translations.translation: The fourth operation is mediation in its third degree, together with the upholding Divine that sustains what has been arranged, and with all the luminous powers of understanding and use brought forth through it.
paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS by presenting mediation and sustentation as a further proceeding.
paragraph_translations.notes: "Pillar of Glory" compressed to sustaining/upholding Divine; exact shade of meaning is uncertain.

paragraph_translations.translation: The fifth operation proceeding from the inmost Divine is truth in splendour as it reaches the outermost, together with all the powers it calls forth for operation—its derivations that pour forth and come into manifestation from it.
paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS by bringing the series to its outward-going operative completion.
paragraph_translations.notes: "Revealed in the elements" required generalization to operation in ultimates; the exact mechanism is unclear.

paragraph_translations.translation: This was arranged so that the Divine operations might be extended in sufficient series: one sufficiency as the subordinate powers of the first engaging good distributed into full function and support of the ordered whole, and another sufficiency as the subordinate powers of the living proceeding Divine extended into a full set of positions and uses, sustaining what has been formed.
paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS by explaining why the sufficiencies were spread out and what they support.
paragraph_translations.notes: The damaged text about "supporting the entire building" was rendered as sustaining the ordered whole.

paragraph_translations.translation: Thus the whole was made complete in organized fullness. To that fullness two were added—reception and compliance—so that responsive conjunction might exist. These were appointed as a succeeding principle in place of the Divine splendour in the lower degree, to govern the outermost plane in which all things are held together.

paragraph_translations.notes: "Great earth" resisted precise rendering; treated as the outermost plane/ultimate degree.

paragraph_translations.notes: Retained the idea of "above/below, outside/within" as degrees and interiors/exteriors; specific named beings were translated by function.

paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS by adding evaluative disclosure and a corrective note about over-raising the unworthy.
paragraph_translations.notes: The clause about "plundered (?)" resisted; rendered as disclosure/unveiling.

spiritual_reading.overall_coherence: Coherent as a single spiritual sequence: source inmost Divine, fivefold proceeding operations, the trial of first engaging good, restorative judgment and constraint of evils, providential inspection of the ordered system, purgative descent of truth in splendour, and the final gathering into a unified human form through reception and compliance. Coherence weakens where the source text is corrupt (¶10, ¶22, ¶27) and where highly physical punitive imagery must be abstracted into states; nevertheless the narrative voice and process remain largely continuous.

findings.diagnosis: Clean opening in correspondential narrative form: conflict is resolved by a functional plurality (“five greatnesses”) without territorial administration.
findings.evidence: Text: “When the battle was raised against the darkness, it was defeated by five greatnesses.” The spiritual reading flows here as a single story of opposition subdued by “a sufficient series of Divine operations,” with no stumble noted.

findings.diagnosis: Correspondential substrate with mild lexical strain: “light-earth” is cosmological/imagistic rather than administrative; difficulty is semantic, not a voice intrusion.
findings.evidence: Text: “Father of Greatness… calm and hiddenness… established in his light-earth, in his own essence.” Reading note: “'Light-earth' required compression… exact nuance is uncertain.” This is a normal translation difficulty, not a narrative break.

findings.diagnosis: Mixed / seam-like systematization. The sentence introduces numeric administration (“appointed to ten parts… established… twelve”) without functional explanation. It reads like a redactional harmonization of two enumerative systems (ten/twelve) inserted into an otherwise descriptive emanation sequence.
findings.evidence: Text: “They were appointed to ten parts, and established in total twelve.” Reading note: “movement from 'ten' to 'twelve'… without retaining numeric schema.” That is precisely a stumble: the reader had to smooth an unexplained renumbering. Skipping the numeric clause would leave a clean line: “Four greatnesses were manifested and came forth of him.”
findings.scope: Remove from ¶3: “They were appointed to ten parts, and established in total twelve.”

findings.diagnosis: Predominantly administrative listing of titled hypostases clustered into “greatnesses.” The teaching is by named ranks (“Mother of Life… First Man… five sons… Beloved of the Lights… Third Ambassador… Pillar of Glory… Jesus the Splendour”), not by function; the spiritual sense has to be imported by paraphrase. This is an overlay of Mani’s administrative voice on top of an older emanation framework.
findings.evidence: Text repeatedly uses identificatory cataloguing: “It is the Mother of Life… together with the First Man and his five sons”; “These are the third greatness”; “The fourth greatness is the Third Ambassador… and all the light powers…” Reading note: “named cluster required translation by function; fine distinctions among titles are not fully recoverable.” That is the hallmark of administrative material: the text itself doesn’t supply the functional ‘why.’
findings.scope: Annotate ¶4-¶7 as an administrative catalogue of hypostatic titles grouped under the five ‘greatnesses’ (emanational ranks), requiring functional reinterpretation to yield correspondences.

findings.diagnosis: Seam-expansion that re-numerates the prior catalogue into two fivefold sets “spread out to five places” to support the ‘building.’ This reads like a systematizing addendum: it does not advance the narrative (emanation → advents) but retrofits the list into a spatial/architectural deployment scheme.
findings.evidence: Text: “It happened, fives… five sons of the First Man… spread out to five places… another five are the five sons of the Living Spirit… spread out to five places.” Reading note flags damage and must generalize: “damaged text… rendered as sustaining the ordered whole.” The “five places” schema is not prepared by ¶4-¶7; it feels like a later harmonizing note placed at a seam before the chapter pivots to the advent-similes (¶10ff).
findings.scope: Remove ¶8 in full: “This is, so that they were spread out and [It happened,] fives: these five [sons] of the First Man [who are spread out to five places, supporting] the entire building; another five are the five sons of the Living Spirit who are spread out to five places, supporting [the whole]”

findings.diagnosis: Expansion at a seam combining (a) a return to the unexplained “twelve parts” total and (b) an institutional mechanism (“summons and the obedience”) installed as “successors” who “rule over” the ‘great earth.’ This is governance language and succession/appointment, not functional correspondence; it interrupts the flow into the advent narratives.
findings.evidence: Text: “total in twelve parts… another two added… the summons and the obedience… appointed as successors to his place… and they rule over…” Reading note shows strain: “'Great earth' resisted precise rendering… treated as the outermost plane.” The reader had to recast concrete administrative appointment/succession into abstract ‘responsive conjunction.’ Skipping ¶9 yields a smoother jump from the fivefold emanation list to ¶10’s first advent simile.
findings.scope: Remove ¶9 in full: “[Thus they are] total in twelve parts that [And they are] another two added to them who are the summons and the obedience. They are the father and the mother whom Jesus the Splendour by his advent has appointed as successors to his place [were appointed] the great earth and the [and they rule over] in them.”

findings.diagnosis: Genuine difficulty due to damage/corruption, not insertion. The paragraph is a coherent correspondential simile (noble son mistreated; humility/endurance) but the Coptic is fragmentary (“companies (?)”, broken syntax), forcing paraphrase.
findings.evidence: Text has multiple breaks: “take from him their companies (?)… Yet, he [his servants] by his humility… restrains his enemy [endures] in silence.” Reading note: “Several phrases were corrupt… rendered as attendant powers.” Removing it would not improve narrative, because it is the hinge into ¶11’s explicit application (“Just as with this man…”).

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondential transition: explicit application of the simile (¶11) and contrast setup for the next advent (¶12).
findings.evidence: Text: “Just as with this man… this also is how the advent… happened”; “In contrast, the advent of the Living Spirit… it differs…” Reading shows no structural stumble here; it uses normal didactic staging (simile → application → contrast).

findings.diagnosis: Predominantly correspondential teaching (simile of a judge restoring order) but with rhetorical hyperbole and graphic penal inventory. The reader’s need to abstract bodily mutilations into ‘faculties’ indicates either stylistic exaggeration or partial secondary embellishment; however the paragraph remains a single coherent simile and drives the narrative forward.
findings.evidence: Text: “blows… leather whips… cutting off their limbs… their ears… imprisonment… hangs by their feet… flay their skin… banish.” Reading note: “Extreme punitive imagery forced rendering… abstraction into faculties and powers.” This is a stylistic/genre strain, not a governance list; it continues the judge-comparison set up in ¶12 and applied in ¶15.

findings.diagnosis: Clean minor extension within the same simile; no administrative jurisdiction, just functional immediacy of executors (“in an instant and haste”).
findings.evidence: Text: “associates… assistants… do the will of their master.” Reading: “swift cooperative agencies.” This supports the judicial-function image; it is not a named territorial roster.

findings.diagnosis: Clean narrative application and eschatological consequence: judgment applied to rulers, differentiated restraints, then permanence until dissolution/fire/separation. Though it contains ‘rulers/powers,’ it is still functional (restraint/placing/weighing), not an administrative roster of named offices.
findings.evidence: Text: “he put each one to the place fitting for him; he weighed each… enclosed… hung… fixed… chain… till the end time… great fire… light goes… darkness remains…” Reading tracks smoothly and reports only mild strain at ¶17’s “Father of Life” wording, which is a source-relationship nuance not a voice break.

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondential simile of inspection/approval with one damaged verb in ¶22 (“plundered (?)”). The passage teaches by function (inspect, see good work, rejoice, confirm; disclose/manifest), not by jurisdiction lists.
findings.evidence: Text: “inspect craftsmen… rejoice… thank… he revealed the hidden things… plundered (?)… unveiled.” Reading note: “clause about 'plundered (?)' resisted; rendered as disclosure/unveiling.” This is localized corruption; removing it is unnecessary because the paragraph’s role is clear and the narrative continues into direct speech approving judgment.

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondential purification sequence (uproot/burn → plant) applied to Jesus the Splendour’s descent, with expected mythic-historical anchoring (“Adam and Eve”). The reader’s compression is interpretive, not prompted by a textual intrusion.
findings.evidence: Text’s functional imagery: “pull out a root… burn… cut… pull out their roots… Afterwards… planted good plants.” Application: “until he reached… Adam and Eve… purified her… gave hope…” Reading notes only that imagery required interiorization; no narrative break occurs.

findings.diagnosis: Strong correspondential substrate: a functional account of ‘summons and obedience’ as a quiet, mixing, gathering, purging, forming process culminating in the Last Statue, reinforced by an extended butter-in-milk simile. Here the pair is taught by what it DOES (mixes, stays in silence, gathers light, discards pollution), unlike ¶9 where it is installed by appointment/succession and rule.
findings.evidence: Text: “it mixed with them, it was established in silence… gather… sculpt… cast… builds upon its body”; simile: “butter… hot milk… melts… clarify and discard… gather.” Reading reports this section as coherent and processual; the spiritual sense arises directly from described operations. This contrast is evidence that ¶9’s ‘summons/obedience’ paragraph is an administrative insertion at the earlier seam, whereas ¶26-¶29 preserves the older functional teaching.

textual_criticism.summary: 12 findings. Recommended excision at two seam-expansions that disrupt the functional narrative with unexplained numeration and governance-installation (¶3 numeric clause; ¶8; ¶9). Recommended annotation for one clear administrative overlay catalogue (¶4-¶7). All other sections read as coherent correspondential substrate, with genuine local damage/lexical uncertainty noted at ¶2, ¶10, ¶22, ¶27 but not improved by removal.

harmonized_paragraphs.text: “[When the battle was raised against] the darkness, it was defeated by five greatnesses.
The first greatness is the Father of Greatness who exists in calm and hiddenness; as he is established in his light-earth, in his own essence.
Four greatnesses were manifested and came forth of him.

The second greatness poured out and was manifested. It was revealed from the first greatness. It is the Mother of Life, the Great Spirit, together with the First Man and his five sons; these are the second greatness.

⟨p.50⟩
The third greatness is the Beloved of the Lights, the Great Builder, the Living Spirit, and the five sons of the Living Spirit. These are the third greatness.
The fourth greatness is the Third Ambassador, and the Pillar of Glory, and all the light powers who were revealed from him. These are the fourth greatness.

The fifth greatness who came from the Father is Jesus the Splendour, and all his powers whom he summoned, his emanations who were [revealed in the elements] They poured out and were manifested from him.

[The advent] of the First Man who came [from the heights to the depths] belonging to [his own household] existing in a kingdom [and is found] esteem before they who belong to his household [and honour] his enemies [but] and suffering by their wickedness; and they take from him [come upon him] and a richness; and they imprison [him in] captivity and take from him their companies (?). Yet, he [his servants] by his humility; and he takes heart and restrains his enemy [endures] in silence.
Just as with this man, this noble son whose enemies surround him, this also is how the advent of the First Man happened, [among the] rulers, the enemies of the light.

In contrast, the advent of the Living Spirit and the commandment that he received, whereby he came upon all the rulers, it differs from that of the First Man. His advent [is not like] the advent of the First Man.

⟨p.51⟩
The advent of the Living Spirit is like this, when he was sent from the greatness that he might bring up the First Man. He resembles a judge the king would send to overturn the violence to that man, the noble son against whom his enemies sinned. And he, this judge, [is firm] hard and cruel [against those who are] and he gives the means [means of salvation] by his righteousness and his strength; and he also judges all who are condemned according to their rebellious heart, and repays each according to his deserts. They who are worthy of blows he strikes with hard leather whips. Again, these who are worthy of cutting off their limbs, or indeed their [their ears] and he repays them accordingly. [Again, those who are worthy of imprisonment] and he binds and fetters them, and hangs by [their feet] and thus he does to them with a righteous judgement. And he kills them to flay their skin [and flay their flesh] so that they will be killed by a death [that is strange and bitter] until they die. Again, [they for] whom it is fitting [to cast out] to banish from their dwellings he may remove according to a righteous judgement; just as they had faulted and sinned against the noble son.
Also, the associates in the mystery and the assistants of this judge, these who belong to him in great strength; in an instant and haste they shall do the will of their master.

Now, just as this genuine judge, who was sent from the king to overturn the violence to this man, the noble son: this is also the case with the Living Spirit. He also was sent from the King of the lights to overturn the vengeance and violence to the First Man, against whom the King of the realms of Darkness had sinned. He faulted and sinned against him, and also his rebellious powers. Therefore, when (the Living Spirit) came, he bore up the First Man.

Also, all the rulers, the powers of sin who had faulted and sinned against the sons of the First Man, he has judged them according to a righteous judgement. He has bound them in heaven and earth. He put each one to the place fitting for him; he weighed each of them according to his cruelty and oppression. While some of them he enclosed in the prison, others he hung head down. Some [among them] are crucified, others are sat down all the time. Some among them are fixed beneath their associates, restricted by a strong chain; others he made the holders of authority over their companions beneath, so that they may do their pleasure amongst these below them.

⟨p.52⟩
Happen you know this [thing,] that when the Father of Life established the judgements [and established] He was revealed to all the powers of darkness. He judged them as a true giver of judgement [in righteousness.] This is the first judgement that the Living Spirit gave the rulers [in respect of the] First Man. Indeed, he gave victory to the First Man corresponding to his victory; but he condemned the King of the realms of Darkness corresponding to that by which he had erred.

[Thus] this chain, of this sort, became [fixed] the earth till the end time when the universe will be dissolved; and it perishes in the great fire and is separated. While the light goes to its country, the darkness remains in the chain and fetter for ever.

The advent also of the Third Ambassador, when he came to inspect they who are imprisoned in the zone: he is like a great king who comes and inspects craftsmen [and soldiers] and [fortifications] and [guards]

Also, they who are good, of the craftsmen and architects and artisans whom he has there in each place: he shall see that they have worked well, and have fallen to his works in their fashion. He shall rejoice with great joy [in their presence] He shall thank the artisans who have constructed his works [and completed] his orders.

Now, just as this great king who comes and inspects his works and fortifications, so also is the advent of the Third Ambassador. For, when he too came, he saw [his works] established and prepared and [arranged] series of the rulers prepared and established there, above and below, outside and within, in the great pattern that his brothers had made. They had come before him to the contest, they who had fixed and created the universe before he came. He saw the gods and the angels established and controlling the fortifications [in a] guarding the entire ruling-power [of the universe] which his first powers had done. They are the First Man and the Living Spirit and the Great Spirit, the Mother of Life.

Therefore, when he saw them, that they had created everything with great wisdom, [he revealed the hidden things] as they looked he plundered (?) [to them] in his advent, by which he came, he was unveiled to them. He says to the Living Spirit: “The judgement that you have [done is] good, what you uttered [to each one,] you gave to them correspondingly; so that they were moved and raised up to that of which they were not worthy”.

⟨p.53⟩
The advent also of Jesus the Splendour, the time when he came to all [the powers below,] being just like a man if he is sent to pull out a [root] burn a difficult fig-garden with fire. Therefore, again, when he has first cut the bad trees with his axe and has pulled out [their roots,] and their body with his fire, so that they should not return to sprout from this time, nor bear fruit bad to eat [from them.]
Afterwards, he also planted good plants: the tree of life that will make good fruit.

Again, this is like this simile of the advent of Jesus the Splendour. It happened like this; because he too set out [to the zone,] his power and his wisdom, in his [compassion]-ness [as] a king and a saviour [and as a healer;] in his glorious wisdom he destroyed them. He bound and crushed them like the fire that shall burn and destroy trees. This is also how he performed his will in the zone, among the many powers, until he reached the form of the flesh of Adam and Eve, the first humans. [He perfected] his will in Eve, he [purified her.] He also gave hope to Adam, and the good news [that he might live;] glorious [that he would be saved,] He went up to the heights [in the glory] of light.

⟨p.54⟩
Then the summons and the obedience, the great counsel that came to the elements, which are set in conjunction: it mixed with them, it was established in silence. It bears up [it] until the end time when it can arise and stand firm in the great fire. It will gather to it its own soul, and sculpt it in the Last Statue. You will also find it sweeps out and casts from it the pollution that is foreign to it. However, the life and the light that are in all things it gathers in to it, and builds upon its body.

The time when this Last Statue will be perfect in all its limbs, then it can become free and ascend from that great struggle through the Living Spirit its father, the one who comes and brings a [each] limb. He brings it up from within this gathering (?), the melting down and destruction of all things.

Now, this counsel, that summons and obedience, resembles thus cooled butter. If a person will take and set it in hot milk, it melts down and soaks in with this hot milk. It melts in another time in silence and quiet to the midst [of it,] yet also, of the power and the taste of this milk [that] is drawn to (the butter), and (the milk) sets and becomes cold [and] in [again,] and the [whey] this milk it shall clarify and discard. However, the oil and the grease and the ‘beauty’ of the milk it shall gather in to it.

⟨p.55⟩
Again, this too is what the advent of that thought is like, the counsel of life, which is the summons and obedience that came to the elements. This is the one that at the end can arise and stand firm, and will gather in to it all the lives, and the light that has remained behind in everything. It can build them upon its body; it will gather them in to it [in calm] in its image for ever and ever [in its form] from this time.

(2) Finding 5—excised ¶8 in full (fivefold spatial deployment seam-expansion). (3) Finding 6—excised ¶9 in full (twelve-parts + summons/obedience succession/governance seam-expansion). All other paragraphs unchanged; Finding 4 was ‘annotate’ only and required no textual modification.
